screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's practise choosing to wait.

screens.title: Now, or something bigger?

cards.caption: A small treat today uses your coins.
Waiting can get you something bigger.

screens.penny: Neither one is naughty, {name}. It's your choice.

screens.story: Nina has 4 coins. Candy costs 4 coins. A soccer ball costs 8 coins.
screens.prompt: Nina really wants the ball. What helps her most?
screens.pennyHint: Which choice gets her the ball, {name}?

options.label: Save 4 more coins
options.outcome: Nina waits two weeks, then has 8 coins. She takes the soccer ball home.

options.label: Buy the candy now
options.outcome: Nina enjoys the candy. Her jar is empty again, so the ball has to wait longer.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Waiting a little got her the bigger thing.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The candy is nice, but the ball needs 8 coins saved up.

screens.prompt: The ball costs 8 coins. Fill Nina's jar.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! The ball needs all 8 coins. Let's count them in.

screens.prompt: Nina waited two weeks to buy the ball. Was that a good plan?
screens.pennyHint: Did she get what she wanted, {name}?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Waiting helped her get the thing she really wanted.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! She did get the ball. Waiting was what made it possible.
screens.retryIntro: Let's think about Nina's plan again, {name}.

screens.title: You did it, {name}!
screens.message: Waiting a little can get you something bigger.
